   **Bugs and stability.**
      10 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 7, 2026 - Sep 15, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Garv Malani_, Sep 14, 2026, 1/5: "the concept is excellent, helping me a lot, but the app is not that great. It feels very slow and every response is delayed. Hope you all will fix it soon"
            2. _deederola_, Sep 13, 2026, 1/5: "Please give us the option to revert. It’s annoying to have to click through so much, the new UI is ugly and counterintuitive. It makes the app unusable."
            3. _The Winter Empress_, Sep 12, 2026, 1/5: "Been using this since college days (2019) and despite the bugs over the years, I never stopped using it. Now I’m uninstalling it. Not sure if the developers know how useful the completion sound was, but removing that was the deal breaker. Before, when background sound was on, I’d know my session was done just by it turning off. Now since the update, I’ve been wasting time and my productivity’s messed up. Maybe some updates later this would be fixed but until then I won’t be using this again and I won’t recommend it to anyone either"
